## `IMakerStudioCatalogSource`

interface · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.Studio.IMakerStudioCatalogSource` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Where the Studio catalog gets its snapshot; the game adapter implements it over the v1 catalog.

<a id="imakerstudiocatalogsource--snapshotasync"></a>

### `Task<MakerResult<MakerStudioCatalogSnapshot>> SnapshotAsync(bool editorVerdicts, CancellationToken cancel)`

The current snapshot, or an error such as `not_ready` or `unavailable`.

**Parameters**

- `editorVerdicts`: True for the pack list: each pack's editability is the editor's final answer, which includes a real write test of the pack folder. False for reading a pack's lines: the rule-based answer is enough and nothing is written.
- `cancel`: Cancels the request.

## `MakerClipStore`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.Studio.MakerClipStore` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Reads per-(language, clip) publication state; writes happen only inside publish/unpublish commits.

<a id="makerclipstore--ctor"></a>

### `MakerClipStore(MakerProjectStore store)`

*Not documented.*

<a id="makerclipstore--read-string-string"></a>

### `MakerClipState Read(string lang, string clip)`

The clip's state. Cheap enough for every row of a catalogue page: it stats the runtime voice files (the derived revision uses size and write time; only a published file is hashed, once per change) and reads one small record. Shared-clip aliases call it with the same clip and agree; the catalogue, the take page and publish all use it.

<a id="makerclipstore--read-string-string-ireadonlylist-string"></a>

### `MakerClipState Read(string lang, string clip, IReadOnlyList<string> files)`

[`MakerClipStore.Read`](#makerclipstore--read-string-string) with the clip's runtime voice files already known (from [`MakerPackFiles.VoiceIndex`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.Editor.md#makerpackfiles--voiceindex), one folder listing for a whole catalogue page).

**Parameters**

- `lang`: The language.
- `clip`: The clip.
- `files`: What [`MakerPackFiles.VoiceFiles`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.Editor.md#makerpackfiles--voicefiles) would return for it.

<a id="makerpackcreator"></a>

## `MakerPackCreator`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.Studio.MakerPackCreator` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Implements: [`IMakerStudioNewPacks`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.md#imakerstudionewpacks)

Creates a content pack for Studio (`POST /v1/maker/studio/packs`, the `newPacks` feature). The skeleton is built in a hidden staging folder of `CWYLS Mods` (the pack scan ignores folders that start with a dot), checked with the loader's own manifest, language and subtitle-table parsers, and moved into place with one rename, so a pack folder never exists half-written and an existing folder is never touched. The creation receipt lives inside the new pack, which is what lets an exact replay answer the same 201 and a reused `operationId` answer 409.

<a id="makerpackcreator--ctor-func-string-func-string-bool-func-string-string-func-string-func-string-action-string-ireadonlydictionary-string-object-iapiclock-action"></a>

### `MakerPackCreator(Func<string> packsRoot, Func<string, bool> isKnownPack, Func<string, string> languageOwner, Func<string> gameVersion, Func<string> loaderVersion, Action<string, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>> publish, IApiClock clock, Action beforeMove)`

Preserves the original constructor entry point for already compiled adapters.

<a id="makerpackcreator--ctor-func-string-func-string-bool-func-string-string-func-string-func-string-action-string-ireadonlydictionary-string-object-iapiclock-action-int-long-long-func-string-long"></a>

### `MakerPackCreator(Func<string> packsRoot, Func<string, bool> isKnownPack, Func<string, string> languageOwner, Func<string> gameVersion = null, Func<string> loaderVersion = null, Action<string, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>> publish = null, IApiClock clock = null, Action beforeMove = null, int maxPackCount = 1024, long maxPackBytes = 8388608, long minimumFreeBytes = 67108864, Func<string, long> freeBytes = null)`

Creates the service.

**Parameters**

- `packsRoot`: The absolute `CWYLS Mods` folder, or null when there is none.
- `isKnownPack`: True when a pack with this id loaded or was refused this session.
- `languageOwner`: The id of the pack that registered a language code this session, or null when the code is unregistered.
- `gameVersion`: The game version to write into the manifest.
- `loaderVersion`: The loader version to write into the manifest.
- `publish`: Event sink; defaults to [`MakerBackends.Publish`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.md#makerbackends--publish).
- `clock`: The clock; defaults to the system clock.
- `beforeMove`: Test seam: runs after staging and before the rename.
- `maxPackCount`: Maximum regular, visible pack folders (including existing packs); defaults to 1024.
- `maxPackBytes`: Maximum bytes in the new pack skeleton; defaults to 8 MiB. Other packs do not count.
- `minimumFreeBytes`: Free space to keep after staging; defaults to 64 MiB.
- `freeBytes`: Test seam for available disk bytes.

## `MakerPackExporter`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.Studio.MakerPackExporter` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Implements: [`IMakerStudioExport`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.md#imakerstudioexport)

Contract v2.3 pack details, icon and export (Pack Maker Phase C). File work only, on the caller's thread, under the pack's store gate so it never interleaves with a Studio save. A durable intent retains the staged ZIP and metadata snapshots until archive installation, metadata and receipt have all settled. Retained archives are never overwritten by later exports.

<a id="makerpackexporter--ctor"></a>

### `MakerPackExporter(Func<string, bool, MakerResult<MakerProjectStore>> open, Func<string, string> pendingRoot, Func<string> exportsRoot, Func<string, string, CancellationToken, Task<MakerResult<MakerStudioGroups>>> progress = null, Action<string, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>> publish = null, IApiClock clock = null, Func<CancellationToken, Task<MakerResult<MakerDlcHidden>>> paid = null)`

**Parameters**

- `open`: The Studio editor's pack opener (pending packs answer 409 `restart_required`).
- `pendingRoot`: The folder of a pack Studio created that the game has not loaded, or null.
- `exportsRoot`: The folder zips are written to, or null when unknown.
- `progress`: The catalogue's groups for (pack, language); optional, warnings only.
- `publish`: The Maker event sink.
- `clock`: The wall clock (tests).
- `paid`: What Pack Maker's DLC gate hides now (the game host wires the catalogue's verdict). Waited for at most 3 s; a failure or timeout is an unknown verdict and refuses the export (fail closed). Null: no gate (offline hosts and tests), no check.

### `static string ExportFileName(string packId, string version, string author)`

The export zip's file name: `<packId>-v<version>.zip`. When the manifest has an author, the slug (lowercase, \[a-z0-9\] only) is not already in the pack id, and a slug is left after the 64-character version segment limit, the name gets `-by-<authorSlug>` too, so a downloader can tell whose pack it is. A name with no usable author slug (none, or only non-Latin letters) is `<packId>-v<version>.zip`.

Publication of a take's prepared render as the pack's runtime voice for one (language, clip), and its removal, each one recoverable commit: the runtime WAV, every moved-aside or restored file, `voice-provenance.json`, the per-clip record and the line. Callers hold the pack gate. Never deletes creator bytes: files in the clip's place are moved under `_maker_backup/`; only Studio's own published WAV (whose bytes the take's render still holds) is deleted.

<a id="makerpublishstore--unpublish"></a>

### `MakerResult<MakerPublishOutcome> Unpublish(MakerStudioUnpublishRequest request, string clip)`

Stops the pack providing a dub for the clip. A Studio publication is deleted and whatever it moved aside is put back; a dub made outside Studio (a v1 upload, a hand-copied file) is moved aside to `_maker_backup/`, never deleted. Either way the clip's provenance entry and record go.

<a id="makerscenecontext"></a>

## `MakerSceneContext`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.Studio.MakerSceneContext` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Where each line sits in the game's novel scripts (Studio v2 `context`): every `NovelMaster` row that speaks the line in a known scenario group is one occurrence, and its previous and next lines are the neighbours in that group's own row order. Nothing is inferred: a row without a group is not an occurrence, a neighbour that is not a line of the game's table is skipped, and mood and pose are never derived from motion identifiers.

<a id="makerscenecontext--novelsource"></a>

### `const string NovelSource = "novel"`

The value of [`MakerStudioContext.Source`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.md#makerstudiocontext--source) for a line that has occurrences.

A context with no occurrence.

<a id="makerscenecontext--build"></a>

Builds the context from the game's novel rows.

**Parameters**

- `novel`: The rows in the game's order.
- `lineExists`: True when the id is a line of the game's localisation table.

<a id="makerscenecontext--occurrencesof"></a>

### `IReadOnlyList<MakerStudioOccurrence> OccurrencesOf(string lineId)`

The occurrences of a line in the game's order; empty when none is verified.

**Parameters**

- `lineId`: A localisation id.

<a id="makerscenecontext--trycontextof"></a>

### `bool TryContextOf(string lineId, string occurrenceId, out MakerStudioContext context)`

Builds the wire context of a line; `occurrenceId` null selects the first occurrence.

**Parameters**

- `lineId`: A localisation id.
- `occurrenceId`: The occurrence asked for, or null.
- `context`: The context on success.

**Returns:** False when `occurrenceId` is not one of the line's occurrences.

<a id="makervoicedefaultstore"></a>

## `MakerVoiceDefaultStore`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.Studio.MakerVoiceDefaultStore` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

The pack's voice origin and consent (contract v2.4), set once so new takes can inherit it. A separate file, so `project.json` (whose parse failure marks a pack unavailable) is untouched. Writes follow [`MakerGlossaryStore.Save`](#makerglossarystore--save): store lock, pending recovery, operation ledger, revision check, receipt, commit. v2.5: inheriting takes follow the default. They are resolved when read (`MakerVoiceDefaultStore.ResolveInherited`), not rewritten, because a normal commit holds at most 100 files and a dubbed pack has far more lines; a change rewrites the disclosures of published inheriting takes in `voice-provenance.json` in the same commit.

<a id="makervoicelabelstore"></a>

## `MakerVoiceLabelStore`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.Studio.MakerVoiceLabelStore` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

D-148: one click labels every shipped dub that has no valid voice label (a hand-copied file, a v1 voice upload, an entry with an unknown origin, an old statement or other bytes) with the pack's voice default, in one recoverable commit of `voice-provenance.json`. Studio publications are never relabelled here: their label follows their take. The confirmation is the creator's click: the request must name the default's revision and origin as the page showed them and carry a confirmed `consent-1`; with no default set nothing is labelled (`consent_required`). Writes follow [`MakerGlossaryStore.Save`](#makerglossarystore--save): store lock, pending recovery, operation ledger, receipt, commit.

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.Studio.MakerVoiceProvenance` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

The pack-root `voice-provenance.json`: published clip disclosures only. It records the creator's assertion (origin, consent statement version and time), the published WAV's SHA-256 and the publication time. It holds no source recording, take id, private note, machine path or identity document, and claims no rights verification.

<a id="makerzipwriter"></a>

## `MakerZipWriter`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.Studio.MakerZipWriter` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Implements: `IDisposable`

A minimal ZIP writer (PKWARE APPNOTE 6.3: local headers, central directory, end record; UTF-8 names; no ZIP64) for the export. It uses `DeflateStream`, the type the trace archive already runs on in the game, and not `ZipArchive`, whose assembly Unity's Mono may not ship. Callers keep the total under 2 GiB.
